patchSql: INSERT INTO supplier_invoice_items(supplier_invoice_id,po_item_id,quantity_billed,unit_price_cents) SELECT 4740,po_item_id,CAST(quantity_billed/2 AS INTEGER),unit_price_cents FROM supplier_invoice_items WHERE supplier_invoice_id=1 AND quantity_billed>=2
UPDATE supplier_invoice_items SET quantity_billed=quantity_billed-CAST(quantity_billed/2 AS INTEGER) WHERE supplier_invoice_id=1 AND quantity_billed>=2
